response.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE res.positionOrder > 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY (AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) IS NULL), avg_laps DESC, r.raceId LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Back-of-the-field means positionOrder strictly greater than 12, so 12 itself is excluded.
Races with no result rows beyond the cutoff are omitted, because the join is an inner join. Races whose laps are all NULL or empty would appear with a NULL average, sorted last.
Ties in the average are broken by raceId ascending.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is inclusive: back-of-the-field means positionOrder >= 12.
